scope: Read-only targeted check of variability denominators and identifiability; no rerun of effects, fitting, fusion or scoring
event_identity_evidence: Registry event ID is hash(pool_id, method, physical_pair_id); within each method and pool, distinct event IDs identify distinct unordered physical endpoint pairs.
allowed_one_arm_variation: At least one arm must change; one arm may remain fixed. Such a panel cannot separately identify both X-member and Z-member contributions.
sampling_limit: Span and sign flip describe the sampled feasible members; no observed flip does not prove permanent stability. Comparing spans across different sample sizes does not by itself rank classifiers.
valid_count_limit: At least two finite metric-valid observations is required. Values may be equal; two equal results legitimately give descriptive span zero, unlike a singleton.
panel_kind_limit: Exact fixed-D and same-composition but varying-D panels remain separate; the latter includes background-member changes.
labor_limit: Each AC labor delta is already legal under within-pair matched recording-source count vectors. This audit did not establish a shared recording-source vector across different AC values in a member panel; their labor span must not be described as a source-controlled pure member effect.
